args.title: Ironbark Tooling newsletter — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter: Ironbark Tooling's latest issue covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" and points to the full article at blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain.
• Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data — and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
• Companion piece: Pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (accessed via the registration link using daniel.ferreira@northwind.example).
